narr: Deep monsoon moisture and slow mid level winds allowed slow moving thunderstorms to produce heavy rain and flash flooding over and below the Pipeline Fire scar. Flash flooding was also seen in Flagstaff.
ev: Heavy rain fell over the Pipeline Fire scar (June 2022) and caused flooding on Highway 89 southbound near road NF-9122H. Flooding also was seen in the Wupatki Trails neighborhood on Camio de los Vientos. Homes and roads were impacted by the flood waters.
Heavy rain flooded the Milton/Route 66 under the railroad overpass in downtown Flagstaff. Cars were caught in the flood water.
lsr: FLOODING ON ROADWAY ON US-89 SOUTHBOUND NEAR NF-9122H (430).
FLOODING IN WUPATKI TRAILS ON CAMINO DE LOS VIENTOS. ROADWAY HAD TO BE CLEARED.
FLOODING OF THE UNDERPASS: RT 66 AND MILTON. CAR STRANDED IN FLOODWATERS.
